name: Chengdu Jian Gong (成都建工)
verdict: Chengdu Jian Gong is the brand of Chengdu Construction Engineering Group, a wholly owned subsidiary of Chengdu Xingcheng Investment Group; its name forms part of Chengdu Rongcheng's chest advertisement in CSL play.
aliases: 成都建工集团有限公司

why.text: Chengdu Jian Gong is the brand of Chengdu Construction Engineering Group, which is wholly owned by Chengdu Xingcheng Investment Group, whose controlling shareholder with 90% is the Chengdu municipal state-assets commission. The UN human rights office found in 2022 that serious human rights violations had been committed against Uyghurs and other mostly Muslim communities in Xinjiang, including large-scale arbitrary detention that may amount to crimes against humanity. So the money behind Chengdu Jian Gong is the Chinese state's.
why.messageLine: The UN human rights office found that China's large-scale arbitrary detention of Uyghurs in Xinjiang may amount to crimes against humanity.
